Diese Kirche dient der Bergbaugemeinde in der Nähe der großen Kohlemine Drummond.
Ez a templom a közeli hatalmas Drummond szénbánya bányászközösségét szolgálja.
Această biserică deservește comunitatea minieră de lângă marea mină de cărbune Drummond.
This church serves the mining community near the large Drummond coal mine.
